The tall T is on the right, with a wide thin horizontal top bar and a narrow stem ending slightly above the foot of L. Each letter has its own distinct material and curve structure.
LEFT LETTER L: entirely made from colorful realistic candies, glossy jelly beans, translucent gummy bears, striped boiled sweets and sugar-coated gumdrops in coral, lemon, mint and lavender. The candies follow a single connected angular Hilbert maze path filling the L, with visible empty gaps between the tiny right-angle turns.
CENTER LETTER O: entirely made from real flowering vines, lush green ivy, delicate leaves, winding woody stems, abundant small white jasmine flowers and blush pink blossoms. These botanical objects follow one continuous two-turn spiral with a clear open center and visible ivory gaps between turns.
RIGHT LETTER T: entirely made from a miniature garden of moss cushions, tiny cream cottages with terracotta roofs, red-capped mushrooms, pebbles and delicate flowers. The miniatures follow a single connected flowing serpentine path, running across the wide thin top bar then back and forth down the narrow centered vertical stem. Visible ivory gaps separate neighboring runs.
The three distinct materials stay within their respective letter paths. Small detailed objects form the letters themselves, no solid backing, no enclosing letter outlines. Realistic material texture, natural daylight, soft contact shadows, sharp intricate detail. Exactly one L, one spiral O and one T. No extra text, no additional LOT words, no borders or visible grid.

samples.prompt:
Photorealistic overhead macro photograph of a futuristic material artwork spelling LOT on a uniform matte midnight navy-blue surface. Square composition, dramatically different materials in each of the three large separated letters. Staggered typography: tall angular L on the left extending to the lower left, large circular spiral O in the middle, T on the right with a wide thin horizontal crossbar and a narrow serpentine stem. Deep blue background remains clearly visible between every neighboring curve. The objects form thin continuous paths, never solid filled letter blocks.
LEFT L: a single connected angular Hilbert labyrinth built from slender polished copper pipes, tiny brass elbows, machined titanium connectors, miniature exposed gears and small teal circuit lights. Precise intricate mechanical craftsmanship. Copper tubes follow every little right-angle turn, preserving the narrow blue maze gaps. Warm metallic copper and silver, no candy.
CENTER O: a single two-turn spiral of translucent iridescent glass spheres, glowing blue and violet glass beads and tiny realistic planet-like mineral orbs, arranged closely along the spiral. Deep cobalt, cyan and violet glass with subtle internal light, delicate reflections, small silver spacers. A clearly open center and clean dark-blue gaps between the turns. The spiral is made of physical glass objects resting on the surface, no drawn orbit lines.
RIGHT T: one continuous serpentine trail of small real amethyst crystals, smoky quartz shards, clear faceted crystals and tiny silver mineral nuggets. The trail runs back and forth across the broad thin top bar, then in short rounded horizontal folds down the narrow centered stem. Violet crystal clusters and sharp transparent facets distributed throughout both the crossbar and the entire stem. Clear navy gaps between runs.
Museum-quality physical assemblage, fine detailed textures, controlled soft side lighting, gentle rim highlights, believable contact shadows. Restrained jewel colors against matte midnight blue. Exactly one L, one spiral O, one T. No extra lettering, no labels, no flowers, no plants, no food, no houses, no borders, no visible grid. Maintain thin separated paths throughout all three letters.
